case.narrative: When I park my car it beeps and says my car is not in park.  Many other models of the 2019 GMC Acadia, along with other GM vehicles, may be affected by a "shift to park" recall. This recall addresses a defect where the vehicle may display a "shift to park" warning message even when the vehicle is actually in park, potentially preventing the ignition from being turned off and the key from being removed.  This is exactly what my car is doing but they say my VIN is not included in the free fix.  I brought my vehicle after it died to a GMC dealership and they said it will cost 1,000 to fix.  My safety is at risk because I drive to different locations as a therapist and I often drive home at night in remote locations.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
